mechanics.name: Still Sight
mechanics.currentEffect: After standing still for 4/3/2 seconds, reveals the Auras of the Killer, Chests, and Generators within 24 m. The effect deactivates when you start moving.
activation: Ends/deactivates when: Moving deactivates the Aura reading.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.1.0): Reduced activation time to 4/3/2 seconds from 6/5/4 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Standing still briefly reveals nearby Killer, Chest, and Generator Auras until you move.
duration: Aura reading continues while stationary and ends when movement begins.
specialInteractions: Reveals Killer, Chest, and Generator Auras within 24 m.

editorial.summary: After standing still for 2 seconds at Tier III, see the Killer, nearby generators, and nearby chests within 24 metres until you move.
useCases: Pause briefly behind cover to check whether the Killer is approaching.
Use the Killer Aura at tall-wall structures where sightlines are poor.
Scout nearby generator and chest positions on unfamiliar maps.
counters: You must stop moving to activate it.
The 24-metre radius is local rather than map-wide.
Aura-blocking or Undetectable effects can remove the most valuable information.
pros: Only two seconds of stillness at Tier III.
Can show the Killer continuously while you remain stationary.
cons: Standing still costs chase and objective tempo.
Easy to misuse by waiting too long for information.
analysis: Still Sight takes this position because the current two-second activation is fast enough to be practical in short scouting pauses. Behind a wall or before committing to an unsafe generator, briefly stopping can reveal exactly where the Killer is within the local area.

The perk is also interesting at tall-wall loops where direct sight is poor. If you can safely become stationary for the activation, the Killer Aura can remove a mindgame entirely until you move again.

The obvious problem is tempo. Dead by Daylight rewards movement and objective work, so a perk that asks you to stand still must answer a question worth the lost seconds. Holding the effect unnecessarily can turn useful information into self-inflicted inefficiency.

Still Sight therefore lands in B as a deliberate scouting tool. It is stronger than its low usage implies, but only when the player uses brief information checks rather than treating stillness as a playstyle.
editorial.verdict: A useful local scouting perk after its faster activation buff. Still Sight rewards short, purposeful pauses, not standing around admiring the Aura colors.
